title: Impersonating a user who must change their password strands the admin on that user's change-password screen
body:
Ruled: 6288774214 · letter E · 2026-10-20T10:23Z

Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-12** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectstack triage routes it.

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** a separate dev-admin session; Users → `qa.plain` → Impersonate User → Continue (`qa.plain` had "Require Password Change On Next Login", the default of Set Password).
- **Expected:** an impersonation session the admin can use and end.
- **Actual:** `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/impersonate-user` 200 and "Now impersonating user", then a full-page "You must change your password — Current password / New password" form for the *target's* password, and 403 toasts ("Saved views for sys_user could not be loaded … PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED"). The only way out is "Sign out instead"; no "stop impersonating".
- **Evidence:** [`07-people-users-impersonating.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/07-people-users-impersonating.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** support admins impersonating new or reset users.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `plugin-auth` (password-reset gate applied to impersonation sessions) / console.
- **Dedupe words:** impersonate password reset required, impersonation dead end.

## Seat review

- **Landing (seat review):** `plugin-auth`'s must-change-password gate applies to an impersonation session. The objectui overlay comes from objectui#12365.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 hits in objectstack, 2 in objectui. Related, closed: objectui#4304 and #4467 (the impersonation banner), and objectui#12365 (which added the change-password overlay). **New.**
